about.title: Positioning & Value Proposition
about.subtitle: A rigorous, outcome-driven testing philosophy designed for engineering speed and product stability
about.q1.title: Who Am I?
about.q1.text: I am Poutchoko Emako Étienne, Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Douala, Cameroon, working remotely with international teams across Europe and worldwide. Over the past 6+ years, I have bridged business requirements, software architecture, and developer delivery speed.
about.q2.title: What Do I Do?
about.q2.text: I do not simply report bugs at the end of a sprint. I design test strategies from the specification stage, automate critical user and API journeys, conduct performance testing, and embed quality gates directly into CI/CD pipelines.
about.q3.title: Which Environments Do I Work In?
about.q3.text: I operate across regulated and high-stakes digital environments: CEMAC regional government regulatory platforms, multi-channel payment gateways (Mobile Money, Visa, PayPal), insurance platforms, and enterprise European SaaS platforms managed in Agile/Scrum.
about.q4.title: What Value Do I Deliver?
about.q4.text: I bring confidence to engineering leadership: measurable reductions in regression cycles (-40%), steep drops in production incidents (-35%), significant automated coverage gains (+60%), and faster release cadence with zero deployment anxiety.
about.q5.title: Why Work With Me?
about.q5.text: Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, proactive teamwork, and seamless communication with distributed stakeholders (developers, product managers, CTOs, and auditors). I adapt to global time zones and build durable testing assets.
about.benefit1.title: Deep Business Context Understanding
about.benefit1.desc: Financial, tax, and regional regulatory compliance.
about.benefit2.title: Actionable & Reproducible Defect Reports
about.benefit2.desc: Clear reproduction steps, logs, and confirmation test runs.
about.benefit3.title: Continuous Agile / Scrum Alignment
about.benefit3.desc: Sprint reviews, daily standups, retrospectives, and product alignment.
expertise.title: QA Methodology & Engineering
expertise.subtitle: End-to-end software quality assurance maturity, from requirements analysis to production monitoring
expertise.card1.title: Test Strategy & Planning
expertise.card1.desc: Designing risk-based test plans, traceability matrices, acceptance criteria, and aligning QA scope with regulatory and business objectives.
expertise.card2.title: E2E & UI Test Automation
expertise.card2.desc: Building scalable, maintainable automation frameworks using Cypress, Playwright, and Robot Framework following Page Object Model (POM) and BDD patterns.
expertise.card3.title: API & Integration Testing
expertise.card3.desc: Validating RESTful APIs, payload structures, schema contracts, and financial transaction flows using Postman and automated test collections.
expertise.card4.title: CI/CD Quality Gates & DevOps
expertise.card4.desc: Embedding automated test executions into GitLab CI and Jenkins pipelines using Docker containers to prevent regressions before merging code.
expertise.card5.title: Performance & Load Testing
expertise.card5.desc: Simulating high concurrent user traffic, stress testing endpoints, analyzing latency metrics, and identifying infrastructure bottlenecks with Gatling.
expertise.card6.title: Defect Lifecycle & Root Cause Analysis
expertise.card6.desc: Full issue traceability in JIRA / Xray and ClickUp, providing detailed reproduction steps, logs, and coordinating regression and verification cycles.
exp.title: Professional Experience
exp.subtitle: Proven track record delivering reliable software for high-impact platforms in Central Africa and Europe
exp.job1.context: Leading QA activities for CEMAC regulatory platforms (ARSy & URBANY—urban and regulatory management systems).
exp.job1.challenge: Ensure bulletproof compliance and reliability across multi-country government systems handling critical approvals and urban planning records.
exp.job1.action: Architected automated E2E frameworks with Cypress, executed API and performance testing with Postman and Gatling, integrated pipelines into GitLab CI/CD, and tracked full test traceability on Xray (JIRA) and ClickUp.
exp.job1.result: Reduced regression testing time by 40%, supervised end-to-end cycles (exploratory, regression, load, UAT), and aligned cross-functional regional stakeholders in Agile/Scrum.
exp.job2.context: Delivered automated QA solutions for European SaaS and digital platforms (notably D4Lean and EZ Trip).
exp.job2.challenge: Accelerate release cycles while slashing defect escape rates on complex SaaS platforms built by distributed European engineering teams.
exp.job2.action: Developed modular automation suites using Cypress, Playwright, and Robot Framework; authored comprehensive test plans and customized manual exploratory strategies; managed issues on JIRA/Xray.
exp.job2.result: Increased test coverage by 60% across client projects, reduced bug escape rates, and drove seamless cross-timezone collaboration in Scrum rituals.
exp.job3.context: QA across multiple SaaS products including digital payments (PayUnit: Mobile Money, Visa, PayPal), insurance (Activa), and automotive (Hallovoiture).
exp.job3.challenge: Secure real-time transaction processing across multiple payment providers and guarantee zero financial data inconsistencies.
exp.job3.action: Executed functional, exploratory, and performance testing; automated core payment journeys with Cypress; integrated test executions into Jenkins CI pipelines.
exp.job3.result: Improved release stability by reducing production defects by 35%, ensuring high uptime and smooth multi-channel payment flows.
exp.job4.context: Full immersion with software development and testing teams.
exp.job4.challenge: Perform early defect identification and structure reusable test cases during rapid iterative sprint cycles.
exp.job4.action: Designed and executed manual test cases, documented defects with detailed reproduction notes on JIRA, and actively contributed to sprint planning meetings.
exp.job4.result: Acquired solid STLC fundamentals and directly contributed to stabilizing early production releases.
